subject: english
topic: Antonyms: word opposite in meaning to the underlined word (mark the target word in CAPITALS in the sentence)

kept.q: Choose the option OPPOSITE in meaning to the word in capitals: The landlord was very LENIENT with tenants who paid their rent late.
kept.explanation: LENIENT means mild or tolerant in dealing with people. The opposite is strict, which means firm and demanding in enforcing rules.
kept.pidgin: Lenient mean say pesin soft-hearted or dey forgive well well when person do wrong. Di opposite na strict, wey mean say pesin tight-fisted and serious with rules.

kept.q: Choose the option OPPOSITE in meaning to the word in capitals: The chief's speech at the coronation was so AMBIGUOUS that the villagers argued over its true meaning.
kept.explanation: AMBIGUOUS means having more than one possible meaning, causing confusion. The opposite is clear, meaning easy to understand with no confusion.
kept.pidgin: Ambiguous mean something wey get plenty meaning, wey dey confuse people. Di opposite na clear, wey mean say something plain and easy to understand.

kept.q: Choose the option OPPOSITE in meaning to the word in capitals: Although the twins looked alike, their characters were strikingly DIVERGENT.
kept.explanation: DIVERGENT means different or moving apart from each other. The opposite is similar, meaning alike or having common features.
kept.pidgin: Divergent mean things wey dey different or dey go separate ways. Di opposite na similar, wey mean say dem resemble each other well well.

kept.q: Choose the option OPPOSITE in meaning to the word in capitals: The governor's VOLUBLE defence of the new policy surprised journalists who expected a short statement.
kept.explanation: VOLUBLE describes someone who talks a lot, fluently and at length. Its opposite, taciturn, describes a person who speaks very little.
kept.pidgin: Voluble na person wey sabi talk plenty grammar up and down without tire. Di opposite na taciturn, wey be quiet pesin wey no like talk too much.

kept.q: Choose the option OPPOSITE in meaning to the word in capitals: Many customers found the trader's prices EXORBITANT compared to other shops in the market.
kept.explanation: EXORBITANT means unreasonably high, especially for a price. The opposite is reasonable, meaning fair and moderate.
kept.pidgin: Exorbitant mean price wey too cost pass normal limit. Di opposite na reasonable, wey mean say price fair and fit person pocket.

kept.q: Choose the option OPPOSITE in meaning to the word in capitals: The soldiers were praised for remaining STEADFAST even when the enemy's attack intensified.
kept.explanation: STEADFAST means firm, loyal, and unshaken in purpose. The opposite is wavering, meaning unsteady or showing indecision.
kept.pidgin: Steadfast mean pesin wey stand gidigba and no dey shake for wetin e believe. Di opposite na wavering, wey mean pesin mind dey shake up and down.

kept.q: Choose the option OPPOSITE in meaning to the word in capitals: Critics described the senator's argument as SPECIOUS once the facts were carefully examined, even though it had sounded convincing at first.
kept.explanation: SPECIOUS describes something that appears true or correct at first but is actually false or misleading. The opposite is genuine, meaning real and truthful.
kept.pidgin: Specious mean something wey look like true at first glance but na lie. Di opposite na genuine, wey mean original and true thing.

kept.q: Choose the option OPPOSITE in meaning to the word in capitals: The accountant's report, though brief, was PERSPICUOUS enough for even non-experts in the boardroom to understand without further explanation.
kept.explanation: PERSPICUOUS means clearly expressed and easy to understand. Its opposite, obscure, means unclear or difficult to comprehend.
kept.pidgin: Perspicuous mean matter wey clear like crystal and easy to grab. Di opposite na obscure, wey mean something dark and hard to understand.
